about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a Staff QA Engineer and SDET based in São Paulo, with 11+ years in quality assurance and test automation across regulated insurance, fintech, agtech and retail. At BNP Paribas Cardif I own the QA automation pipeline for a 9-person QA team, and I lead its modernization from a legacy Selenium/Jenkins setup to Playwright on GitLab CI/CD, cutting daily pipeline runtime by up to 67%.

Today my focus is AI in testing: human-supervised agentic workflows where AI subagents, custom MCP servers and an internal enterprise AI platform do the heavy lifting, and QA engineers keep the final say. I work in English, Spanish and Portuguese with business and technical stakeholders across Latin America and Europe, and I'm open to remote roles in US time zones.

ai_focus.title: AI-driven testing, with a human in the loop
ai_focus.intro: At Cardif I designed an agentic testing workflow where AI subagents turn a user story into executed, documented tests. AI drafts and runs the work. Two QA engineers review and approve every change before it goes anywhere.

pipeline.title: Read the story
pipeline.text: An AI subagent reads the user story and its acceptance criteria.

pipeline.title: Draft the strategy
pipeline.text: The agent drafts a test strategy for the story's risks and scope.

pipeline.title: Generate BDD
pipeline.text: BDD/Gherkin scenarios are generated and reviewed against the business behavior.

pipeline.title: Write test code
pipeline.text: Playwright (JavaScript) test code is generated and reviewed.

pipeline.title: Run in Playwright

pipeline.title: Human approval
pipeline.text: Two QA engineers do a final review of every change before approval.

capabilities.title: Custom MCP server
capabilities.text: Built a Model Context Protocol server that connects AI agents to non-production environments. A proof of concept unifies token-based integrations across proxies and backend services into a single shell call, turning a manual, multi-tab process into seconds.

capabilities.title: AI enablement and training

capabilities.title: AI-generated evidence reports

featured.tagline: Owning the QA pipeline and bringing agentic AI into insurance testing.
featured.context: Insurance products in a regulated, multicultural B2B2C environment, working with stakeholders across Latin America and Europe. I own the automation pipeline for a 9-person QA team and lead its modernization.
highlights: Cut daily pipeline runtime by up to 67% vs. the legacy Java-based Jenkins pipeline by replacing flaky Selenium tests with stable Playwright end-to-end tests. 250+ UI tests and API tests covering 95+ APIs now finish in 33 minutes or less.

Designed a human-in-the-loop agentic AI testing workflow: AI subagents go from user story to test strategy, BDD scenarios, Playwright code, execution and ALM Octane evidence, with final approval from two QA engineers.

Built a custom MCP server connecting AI agents to non-production environments, paired with Playwright MCP, plus a proof of concept that reduces a manual multi-tab token process to a single shell call taking seconds.
Lead the migration of the legacy test pipeline to GitLab CI/CD (risk mitigation, optimization, Git configuration) while moving the Selenium/Cucumber suite to Playwright (JavaScript).
Own the main branch and review and approve every merge request promoted from develop to main for a 9-person QA team.

Introduced automated progression testing on every new DEV deployment, followed by UAT validation with stakeholders. Lead AI enablement as the team's QA trainer and report automation and AI-adoption performance to management.
featured.ai_angle: This is where I build and run agentic AI testing in production QA work: MCP integrations, AI-generated BDD and test code, and a two-person human review gate on every change.

featured.tagline: Taking a global agtech platform from Test & Learn to production.
featured.context: Led QA for the Valora Global Program, an agtech platform that engages farmers in Climate's planting and harvest planning, across web, mobile and backend.
highlights: Led QA validation for the Valora Global Program and drove its transition from a Test & Learn environment to a production-integrated platform.
Designed, built and maintained scalable automated web test suites with Cypress and Playwright, integrated into CI/CD pipelines with development and DevOps teams.
Managed merge requests and kept release cycles stable.
Delivered a consistent cross-platform experience through behavioral testing on Android and iOS physical devices and emulators.
Improved backend reliability by validating REST API endpoints with Postman and Swagger.
Authored test plans and technical documentation, and worked with stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess risks and close coverage gaps.
featured.ai_angle: The Playwright and CI/CD engineering I did at Bayer is the foundation my AI-generated tests run on today. Agentic testing only pays off when the framework underneath is stable.

featured.tagline: Seven years of enterprise QA across telecom, retail and financial services.
featured.context: Grew from intern to mid-level QA analyst across several client engagements, covering SAP, mobile and functional testing in Agile/Scrum teams.
highlights: Progressed from intern to mid-level QA analyst over 7 years across telecom, retail and financial services clients.
Automated SAP functional and regression suites with Tricentis Tosca.
Automated native, hybrid and web mobile tests with Appium on iOS and Android.
Covered a wide range of platforms by testing on physical devices and simulators.
Defined and executed functional and behavioral test strategies with supporting technical documentation, in Agile/Scrum ceremonies with cross-functional teams.
featured.ai_angle: Years of enterprise regression and cross-device testing taught me what good coverage looks like, and that's what I check for when I review AI-generated tests.

earlier.summary: Automated mass card-generation workflows using Test Data Management (TDM) and ran jobs and complex queries in IBM mainframe environments.
Investigated production issues with Snowflake SQL, tested new metrics in UAT, validated MicroStrategy BI reports and built Power BI monitoring dashboards.

items.title: CypressTestingAPI
items.subtitle: Cypress + JavaScript · API automation
items.description: An end-to-end API test suite for the public ServeRest API, independent of any front end. Specs are organized by domain across three business flows: users and authentication (POST /usuarios, POST /login), products (POST and GET /produtos) and the cart from start to finish (POST and DELETE /carrinhos). Tests check status codes, messages, tokens and response data, and use @faker-js/faker for test data.

about.title: Sobre
paragraphs: Sou Staff QA Engineer e SDET em São Paulo, com 11+ anos em garantia de qualidade e automação de testes nos setores regulados de seguros, fintech, agtech e varejo. Na BNP Paribas Cardif, sou dono do pipeline de automação de QA de um time de 9 pessoas e lidero a modernização de um setup legado em Selenium/Jenkins para Playwright no GitLab CI/CD, reduzindo o tempo do pipeline diário em até 67%.

Hoje meu foco é IA aplicada a testes: fluxos agênticos supervisionados por humanos, em que subagentes de IA, servidores MCP customizados e uma plataforma corporativa de IA fazem o trabalho pesado, e os engenheiros de QA dão a palavra final. Trabalho em inglês, espanhol e português com stakeholders de negócio e técnicos na América Latina e na Europa, e estou aberto a vagas remotas em fusos horários dos EUA.

featured.tagline: Dono do pipeline de QA e responsável por trazer IA agêntica aos testes de seguros.
featured.context: Produtos de seguros em um ambiente regulado, multicultural e B2B2C, com stakeholders na América Latina e na Europa. Sou dono do pipeline de automação de um time de QA de 9 pessoas e lidero sua modernização.
highlights: Reduzi o tempo do pipeline diário em até 67% em relação ao pipeline legado em Jenkins (Java) ao substituir testes Selenium instáveis por testes end-to-end estáveis em Playwright. 250+ testes de UI e testes de API em 95+ APIs agora terminam em 33 minutos ou menos.

Desenhei um fluxo de testes com IA agêntica e humano no circuito: subagentes de IA vão da user story à estratégia de testes, cenários BDD, código Playwright, execução e evidências no ALM Octane, com aprovação final de dois engenheiros de QA.

Construí um servidor MCP customizado que conecta agentes de IA a ambientes não produtivos, combinado com o Playwright MCP, além de uma prova de conceito que reduz um processo manual de tokens com várias abas a uma única chamada de shell que leva segundos.
Lidero a migração do pipeline de testes legado para o GitLab CI/CD (mitigação de riscos, otimização, configuração do Git) enquanto migro a suíte Selenium/Cucumber para Playwright (JavaScript).
Sou responsável pela branch main e reviso e aprovo cada merge request promovido de develop para main em um time de QA de 9 pessoas.

Implantei testes de progressão automatizados a cada novo deploy em DEV, seguidos de validação em UAT com stakeholders. Lidero a capacitação em IA como instrutor de QA do time e reporto à gestão o desempenho da automação e da adoção de IA.
featured.ai_angle: É aqui que construo e opero testes com IA agêntica no trabalho real de QA: integrações MCP, BDD e código de teste gerados por IA, e uma revisão humana feita por duas pessoas em cada mudança.

featured.context: Liderei o QA do Valora Global Program, uma plataforma de agtech que engaja agricultores no planejamento de plantio e colheita da Climate, em web, mobile e backend.
highlights: Liderei a validação de QA do Valora Global Program e conduzi sua transição de um ambiente Test & Learn para uma plataforma integrada à produção.
Projetei, implementei e mantive suítes escaláveis de testes web automatizados com Cypress e Playwright, integradas a pipelines de CI/CD em conjunto com os times de desenvolvimento e DevOps.
Gerenciei merge requests e mantive ciclos de release estáveis.
Garanti uma experiência consistente entre plataformas com testes comportamentais em dispositivos físicos e emuladores Android e iOS.
Aumentei a confiabilidade do backend validando endpoints de API REST com Postman e Swagger.
Escrevi planos de teste e documentação técnica, e trabalhei com stakeholders para esclarecer requisitos, avaliar riscos e fechar lacunas de cobertura.
featured.ai_angle: A engenharia de Playwright e CI/CD que fiz na Bayer é a base sobre a qual meus testes gerados por IA rodam hoje. Testes agênticos só valem a pena quando o framework por baixo é estável.

featured.context: Cresci de estagiário a analista de QA pleno em diversos projetos de clientes, com testes de SAP, mobile e funcionais em times Agile/Scrum.
highlights: Evoluí de estagiário a analista de QA pleno ao longo de 7 anos, em clientes de telecom, varejo e serviços financeiros.
Automatizei suítes funcionais e de regressão de SAP com Tricentis Tosca.
Automatizei testes mobile nativos, híbridos e web com Appium em iOS e Android.
Cobri uma grande variedade de plataformas testando em dispositivos físicos e simuladores.
Defini e executei estratégias de testes funcionais e comportamentais com documentação técnica, em cerimônias Agile/Scrum com times multifuncionais.
